facts: The USDA commissioned South Carolina State University's virtual campus twin from DTS.
Our food-safety training for the Louisiana Department of Health won Unity's “Best Public Health Solution” award at I/ITSEC.
One build, every device — phone, desktop, or headset. No separate versions.
DTS is SAM.gov qualified — cleared to contract directly with federal and state agencies.
A digital twin isn't a video — it's dimensionally accurate. You could measure a room straight from your browser.
We don't organize by industry — we organize by the systems that shape human life: education, industry, government, community.
Every new capture adds to a community's spatial record — it never really finishes.
Spaces are captured with a Matterport Pro3 and an Insta360 Pro 2, then published as navigable space on Treedis.
A hotel, a campus, and a state health department are the same problem: a real place, made navigable.
Government moves on different timelines than industry. We build for both.
Tags and hotspots turn a flat scan into something you can actually explore, not just look at.
Preservation-grade capture means a historic building stays documented even as it changes.
Most spatial data dies in a folder somewhere. A digital twin is built to be walked through.
